system.description:
Once per scene, when you create a Breach in a network, you can enter a Deep Dive.

While in a Deep Dive:
• You can interact with connected systems in the scene regardless of range.
• Gain a bonus equal to your Tier on Interface Rolls involving Hacking or Network cards.
• You can ask the GM one question about the network, its security, connected systems, or hidden routes.

The Deep Dive ends when you take major damage, disconnect, or the scene ends.
